changelog:
Initial release of the SystemDesign skill, providing CTO-level guidance for AI-native architecture.

- Advises on complex system design, architectural decisions, resilience, scalability, state management, and system migrations.
- Reviews AI-generated code for architectural soundness and helps define design.md documents.
- Aggressively triggers on prompts involving keywords such as architecture, scale, resilience, state, refactor, observability, concurrency, and more.
- Outlines clear audit processes and code review checklists for state ownership, feedback/observability, and dependency mapping.
- Equips teams to think at the system architecture level, not just code implementation.
